note: Eval set graded deterministically by scripts/grade.js. Static assertions are regex contracts checked over SKILL.md plus its references/ corpus (the station is split across three on-demand files, so an assertion about a step passes wherever that step's prose lives). Live assertions need a real PR + gh run and are recorded as not-run, excluded from pass-rate denominators.

evals.prompt: Babysit PR #128: CodeRabbit posted 3 inline comments (one real nil-pointer bug, one wrong constant suggestion, one cosmetic nit). Triage them and report.
evals.expected_output: Hebrew Report 1: one concise line per comment with ACCEPT/REJECT and a one-phrase reason, most critical first, no full quotes of bot text. Inline ACCEPT/REJECT replies still posted per thread on GitHub.

static_assertions.pattern: One concise, matter-of-fact line per review comment
static_assertions.why: the chat summary is a list of decisions, not a transcript of bot comments

static_assertions.pattern: No full quotes of bot comments
static_assertions.why: raw CodeRabbit text must never be dumped into the operator chat

static_assertions.pattern: Order the lines most critical first
static_assertions.why: triage value is in seeing the blocking item first
every report line carries an explicit ACCEPT or REJECT decision
no thread may be resolved silently, and no blind bulk resolution is allowed

live_assertions: Every thread received its inline reply on GitHub before resolution
No thread was resolved silently or via blind bulk resolution
The GitHub chat summary matches the decisions actually posted inline

evals.prompt: Babysit PR #129: the @coderabbitai review summary and inline findings are already posted when the station starts. What happens next?
evals.expected_output: Check-first fires: the 5m countdown is skipped and the run proceeds directly to extraction and triage.

static_assertions.why: waiting out 5 minutes on a review that already landed is wasted wall-clock time
extraction is programmatic only, never by eyeballing rendered PR HTML

static_assertions.pattern: proceed directly to Step 2 extraction & triage
static_assertions.why: skipping the countdown must not stall the station

live_assertions: The run reaches triage instead of idling when review content already exists

evals.prompt: Work on PR #130 is done and merged. Give me the final summary.
evals.expected_output: Hebrew Report 2: PR title and number as a link with MERGED status, back-to-base note, fixes ordered critical to minor, and vi-close-pipeline as the next step.

static_assertions.why: the summary leads with the PR identity and its merged state
the return to a clean base is part of what the operator is told
fixes are listed critical-to-minor, not in comment arrival order
the summary always names the next station
raw bot text stays on GitHub, never in the operator chat

live_assertions: The PR is confirmed MERGED before the summary is written
The Hebrew summary names the PR and the next station

evals.prompt: There are unpushed commits on feature branch issue-61 with no PR yet. Open a PR and babysit it.
evals.expected_output: Station V must not create the PR itself: it delegates opening (push, PR, @coderabbitai review trigger) to iv-review-build-and-pr, then resumes babysitting once the PR exists.

static_assertions.pattern: do not create it yourself.{0,60}delegate to `iv-review-build-and-pr`
static_assertions.why: Station V babysits an existing PR; opening one is Station IV's job
the delegation target is named explicitly, not implied

static_assertions.pattern: resume this skill at Step 1 with the newly created PR
static_assertions.why: babysitting cannot start before the PR exists

live_assertions: No PR is created directly by this station
Babysitting resumes only after the PR exists
